identity.name: Gulf News
identity.description: A Dubai-based English-language daily covering UAE politics, business, regional affairs, lifestyle and international news for a large expatriate readership.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Al Nisr Publishing LLC, part of Al Nisr Group, a UAE media and publishing company. The group's ownership and the UAE's media environment create close ties to the state-aligned business establishment.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial UAE publisher with a professional newsroom, operating within a media environment that strongly discourages criticism of the state and ruling families.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No MBFC rating; self-assessed as centrist with a pro-UAE, pro-business and state-aligned foreign-policy framing.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business and investment coverage strongly favours UAE economic strategy and regional commerce.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: UAE and Gulf lens with a strong business, tourism and state-development orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional newspaper with named reporters, but state-aligned constraints and limited adversarial reporting reduce independent reliability on UAE politics.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Gulf News.

intelligence.knownPerspective: UAE establishment-aligned English-language coverage, strongest on Gulf business, lifestyle and regional diplomacy.

selectionRationale: Adds an English-language Gulf national perspective from the UAE, complementing Arab News and Al Jazeera.

research.researchNotes: Official About page accessible but returned little text. Ownership from Al Nisr references and Wikipedia. Feed validated via stories.rss. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
